paper_title: First results of the CAST-RADES haloscope search for axions at 34.67 $μ$eV
notes: First results of CAST-RADES haloscope (2018 data, CERN CAST dipole magnet, 8.384 GHz filter-like 5-sub-cavity). Measured 95% credibility exclusion limit g_agamma > ~4e-13 GeV^-1 over the narrow mass range 34.6738-34.6771 ueV. Assumed local DM density rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (Read 2014) and standard isothermal halo Maxwell-Boltzmann lineshape. The paper quotes a single representative coupling value for the band (detailed frequency-dependent limit shown only in Figure 9 inset, not tabulated), so a two-point flat line spanning the stated validity range is emitted. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 2))
